contract: Coffee "C" Metric futures (ICE Futures U.S., symbol AC)
source: ICE Futures U.S. Rulebook Chapter 14 Coffee "C" Metric Futures and Options (Appendix IV Schedules C-2/C-3, Appendix V, Appendix VI, Appendix VIII); ICE Submission 25-157 (Aug 21 2025)
units: US$ per metric ton; negative = discount to the futures price

eudr_transition.note: Appendix VIII: Transition Stocks discount from the May 2028 contract, $121/t plus $11/t per calendar month thereafter; not for Legacy Stocks or coffee graded on/after Dec 30 2026

packaging: natural-fibre bags (as KC) or new woven polypropylene FIBCs up to 1 t (ISO 21898 class 3.1.3); a lot is all bags or all FIBCs; FIBC = 15 bags for load-out
certificates_note: Neither Chapter 14 nor Submission 25-157 says whether coffee holding a Chapter 8 (KC) Certificate of Grade is deliverable on AC; a re-submission ban applies as in KC (Rule 14.10(a)).
